content:
As Amazon's updated early autumn Prime Day mega-sale kicks off, coupled with a massive $500 discount on the M5 Pro MacBook Pro, today's top story on 9to5Toys Lunch Break features multiple models of the iPhone 17 Pro Max priced up to $513 lower than the 18 Pro (Renewed Premium). We also have ecobee's official early autumn Prime Day HomeKit deals going live today, with smart thermostats, bundles and more discounted by up to $210; plus a range of Apple accessories on sale: Solo Loop bands for $7 or less, a rare $100 discount on the Apple Magic Keyboard Folio, and an official MagSafe battery pack at 40% off. Below, plenty more deals on chargers, TVs, smart speakers and more await you.

Amazon is currently offering multiple iPhone 17 Pro Max models priced up to $513 lower than the 18 Pro (Renewed Premium)

We've pounced on a few opportunities to grab iPhone 17 Pro deals directly from Amazon, but this is the first time we've seen unlocked Renewed Premium models hit significant discounts, arriving alongside the early autumn Prime Day deals. The iPhone 18 Pro Max is already out, but you can now pick up a similarly specced 17 Pro for over $500 less. Details below.

You can currently find the 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Max starting from $1,385.78 with free shipping. That's $213 below this model's original new price, and a full $513 cheaper than Apple's 1TB 18 Pro Max.

Apple launched the 1TB iPhone 18 Pro Max at $1,899 this month. While the 1TB 17 Pro Max wasn't priced quite that high at original launch, its price has since crept up — so thanks to Amazon's top-tier Premium Renewed listings, you're getting a pretty solid discount right now.

Only the Deep Blue colour model can be had for quite this low a price direct from Amazon, but the other colours are still well below the 1TB iPhone 18 Pro Max's price:

  • Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB, Cosmic Orange (Renewed): $1,499 (originally $1,599)
  • Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max, 1TB, Deep Blue (Renewed): $1,386 (originally $1,599)

Apple's refurbished store still doesn't carry the iPhone 17 series, so what we're looking at here are Amazon's top-tier models, backed by a full one-year Amazon Renewed guarantee and 'over 90% original battery health' — these aren't your typical refurbished units.

Here are the current prices for iPhone 17 Pro Amazon Renewed Premium models:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (normally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (normally $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (normally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (normally $1,299 new)

M5 Pro MacBook Pro now $500 off at Amazon, Silver and Space Black both available

The latest M5 MacBook Air deals are still going strong, but we want to circle back to this $500 discount on the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro from Amazon — both the Space Black and Silver models have dropped to this heavily discounted price.

Amazon is currently selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and 2TB of storage for $2,699 with free shipping.

This price matches the lowest we've tracked over the past few months, but now both Space Black and Silver are in stock — the latter doesn't typically get marked down quite as frequently as the black one.

Apple Solo Loop clearance officially underway: one for $7, two for $10, three for $15 (originally $49 and up)

To coincide with the early autumn Prime Day deals, Woot has just launched a full clearance event on official Apple Braided Solo Loop and Solo Loop Apple Watch bands. Each band has been slashed to just $6.99 with Prime shipping, and buying two or more gets you an extra 30% off at checkout.

We've seen plenty of Apple Solo Loop deals over the past year, but none quite as good as this. We expect colours and sizes to sell out fast — at these prices, grab your picks while you can.

Solo Loops originally go for $49, so even picking up just one is a steal. But buy two or more with the extra 30% off and the value gets almost absurd:

  • Apple Solo Loop $7 (originally $49 and up)
  • 2-pack Apple Solo Loop $10 (originally $98 and up)
  • 3-pack Apple Solo Loop $15 (originally $147 and up)

Colours and sizes are already starting to go out of stock — we'll say it again: get them while they're still available.

Rare $100 discount! Apple iPad Magic Keyboard Folio marked down at Amazon

ecobee official early autumn Prime Day HomeKit deals go live today: up to $210 off smart thermostats, bundles and more

We're still in the middle of the early autumn Prime Day window with thousands of deals to sort through, and ecobee has let 9to5Toys know that their official Prime Big Deal Days promotions are actually starting today. From now through October 7th, their popular lineup of HomeKit smart thermostats, along with bundle combos offering over $200 in savings, will all be discounted.

ecobee official early autumn Prime Day deals go live today

While these deals don't carry an official Prime Day tag on their listings, the prices already reflect official early autumn Prime Day discounts — many matching what we tracked during the summer Prime Day event. Outside of their main seasonal blowouts, this brand rarely discounts this deeply across such a wide range of models, so if you're looking to upgrade your smart home, now's the time to move.

This big launch deal joins the early autumn Prime Day savings lineup, with Fire TV Sticks and other streaming devices starting from $16.

Fire TV Stick early autumn Prime Day deals:

Amazon just unveiled a wave of upcoming early autumn Prime Day deals

All-new M6 Mac mini and Mac Studio launch deals return to Amazon (up to $50 off)

After this morning's massive $500 discount on the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, Amazon has also brought back all launch deals on the brand-new M6 Mac mini and M5 Max Mac Studio.

Both the 2026 Mac mini with the brand-new M6 chip, and the high-end M5 Pro models available from Amazon, have been slashed back to all-time low prices:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (originally $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (originally $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (originally $1,299)
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (originally $1,699)

The brand-new Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM and 512GB of built-in storage has also been discounted by $50 off its regular price, same situation:

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,449 (originally $2,499)

The discounts aren't huge, but for anyone looking to upgrade at launch, this is the lowest Amazon is currently offering. With all configurations back at all-time low prices, we wanted to make sure you didn't miss these deals as we kick off a new work week.
